commands.name: search-content
commands.summary: Keyword search across RNZ news stories and audio items, with paging.

commands.name: list-tag-stories
commands.summary: List stories tagged with a topic slug, e.g. housing.

commands.name: list-section-news
commands.summary: List the latest news stories in a news section, e.g. education, political, world, business or sport.

commands.name: list-author-articles
commands.summary: List articles written by an RNZ reporter, identified by author slug.

commands.name: get-news-feed
commands.summary: Get the latest stories in a news category from its RSS feed (structured title, link, date, description).

commands.name: list-rss-feeds
commands.summary: List all available RNZ RSS feeds and their URLs.

commands.name: get-news-article
commands.summary: Get a news article's headline, description, publish time and body text.

commands.name: get-audio-item
commands.summary: Get metadata (headline, description, dates, image) for a radio programme audio item.

commands.name: list-life-articles
commands.summary: List RNZ Life (arts, culture, music, lifestyle) articles in a category such as music.

commands.name: get-life-article
commands.summary: Get an RNZ Life article's headline, description and body text.

commands.name: list-podcasts
commands.summary: List all RNZ podcasts (A–Z) with their slugs.

commands.name: get-podcast-episodes
commands.summary: Get a podcast's recent episodes from its RSS feed, including title, date, duration and MP3 URL.

commands.name: list-podcast-episodes-by-year
commands.summary: List a podcast's episodes published in a given year (an archive beyond the RSS feed's latest items).

commands.name: get-national-schedule
commands.summary: Get the RNZ National radio schedule (programmes) for a date; returns today's schedule when no date is given.

commands.name: list-video-series
commands.summary: List RNZ video series and documentaries, with their slugs.
